name: old-beach
title: old-beach
blurb: a serene beach that ages you: sit, and the longer you linger the more of your life the tide takes. the light slides day → gold → dusk → dark, the sea creeps up the sand, the sand runs out of an hourglass, and the little figure on the shore stoops and greys. get up and leave, or stay until the horizon goes out. @goose.art asked for "a beach that makes you old."
